name: zee
for: model who may do what inside the client's own app (owners, editors, viewers, inherited access, separation of duties) as a relationship-based model on the ab0t auth service, audit it, and preview who gains and loses before any change
sops_note: Zee predates the SOP method; its procedure lives in the six zzb skills. Client SOPs and GAPS.md are the next job for this folder.

hands_off_to.for: sign-in, the mesh permission names, keys, environments (zzb apply / init --with-tenancy can drive authsetup)

answers: can user X do Y on object Z, and why (the grant path)
who can access object Z with permission P
does this model have wildcard over-grants, dark permissions, or self-approval paths (zzb audit)
dangerous_defaults: zzb targets https://auth.service.ab0t.com (prod) unless --url or ~/.zzb/config.json says otherwise
